title: Terrible Subscription Cancellation Process!
body: For several days, I couldn’t cancel my subscription because the support chat was completely unavailable. The “Contact Us” section displayed only an email address instead of a chat, apparently due to technical issues. I emailed support multiple times, providing my account ID, payment confirmations, and bank screenshots. Despite having all this information, they refused to help and kept directing me to a chat that wasn’t available! Days later, the chat finally became accessible, and I was able to cancel. Why couldn’t support process my cancellation by email? Customers shouldn’t have to struggle for days just to cancel a subscription. Absolutely unacceptable!
